definition: to have no time left to finish
description: An exam in a large hall with tall windows and a big clock on the wall. A tall young man in a navy jumper, the supervisor, stands at a desk and pulls away an exam paper while looking up at the ceiling. The young woman in a green cardigan sitting there holds on to the paper and keeps writing on it, desperate to finish, until he takes it from her. He stands holding the paper with his eyes closed, and she sits back with her pen in her hand. Rows of students sit at small desks behind them.

taps.phrase: to gaze up at the ceiling
to scribble on the exam paper
